temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say it has been tough and that she keeps wondering if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed the patient's death was a sad shared loss and that Shirley, as a caring colleague, would be affected, but she was not yet sure how deeply Shirley was grieving.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara moves from uncertain concern to recognizing that Shirley is deeply affected and may be second-guessing the care they provided.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving strongly and may be carrying self-doubt or regret about the patient's death.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to comfort and reassure Shirley, reminding her of the good care they provided and offering support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Shirley tells Sara that she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different treatment approach might have changed the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and possibly second-guessing the outcome, but she was not certain Shirley felt personally responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Shirley explicitly confirms that she feels burdened by responsibility for the treatment outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley carries a strong sense of responsibility or guilt about the patient's death and needs help reframing that burden.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: empathy, concern, and a wish to alleviate Shirley's guilt
temporal_state_chain.intention: to reassure Shirley that they made the best decisions with the available information and that she should not carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes that Shirley has remained reserved and minimally expressive, and Shirley admits she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak by showing her feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still grieving and possibly suppressing her emotions, but she did not know that Shirley's restraint was driven by fear of appearing weak or unprofessional.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara learns the reason Shirley has been holding back and hears that Shirley may be willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is suppressing her feelings because she fears judgment, but that gentle encouragement from a trusted friend may help her open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to encourage Shirley to express her emotions safely and to reassure her that openness is not weakness, especially among friends.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong, and Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well. Shirley appreciates the apology and wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worried that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and possibly damaged trust; she believed Shirley had agreed to try opening up but might have felt pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Shirley confirms that the confrontation felt like a bit much, but also that she understands Sara's intent and values the apology and continued support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes she did overstep somewhat, but that Shirley forgives her and wants their supportive conversations to continue; Sara should be gentler and follow Shirley's pace.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to mend the friendship, remain available for Shirley, and support her without pushing too hard.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems improved, Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and Shirley agrees to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still healing but making progress, and that their conversations were helping; she hoped to continue supporting her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Shirley confirms she is feeling better and attributes improvement to Sara's support, and she welcomes more time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is doing better, that her support has been meaningful, and that their friendship can continue to grow beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to continue supporting Shirley, plan a weekend activity, and maintain their supportive friendship.
